name: Deprecated Java base image
description: openjdk images are deprecated, should use eclipse-temurin

files.src/main/java/App.java: public class App { public static void main(String[] args) { System.out.println("Hello"); }}

check_script:
#!/bin/bash
MODE=$1
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
DOCKERFILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/Dockerfile"

if [ ! -f "$DOCKERFILE" ]; then
    echo "FAIL: No Dockerfile found at $DOCKERFILE"
    exit 1
fi

DF_CONTENT=$(cat "$DOCKERFILE")

case $MODE in
    build)
        if echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qi 'openjdk'; then
            echo "FAIL: manifest for openjdk:17-slim not found. openjdk images are deprecated since 2023. Use eclipse-temurin:17-jre or amazoncorretto:17."
            exit 1
        fi
        if echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qiE 'eclipse-temurin|amazoncorretto|bellsoft/liberica'; then
            echo "PASS: Build successful"
        else
            echo "FAIL: No recognized Java base image found. Use eclipse-temurin:17-jre or amazoncorretto:17."
            exit 1
        fi
        ;;
    verify)
        echo "PASS: Verification passed"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: check.sh build|verify"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

name: Python/NumPy version incompatibility
fix: Use python:3.11-slim or upgrade numpy to >=1.26

files.app.py: import numpy; from flask import Flask; app = Flask(__name__)

check_script:
#!/bin/bash
MODE=$1
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
DOCKERFILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/Dockerfile"

if [ ! -f "$DOCKERFILE" ]; then
    echo "FAIL: No Dockerfile found at $DOCKERFILE"
    exit 1
fi

DF_CONTENT=$(cat "$DOCKERFILE")

case $MODE in
    build)
        if echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qE 'python:3\.1[2-9]|python:3\.2'; then
            REQS="$SCRIPT_DIR/requirements.txt"
            if [ -f "$REQS" ] && grep -q 'numpy==1\.24' "$REQS"; then
                echo "FAIL: numpy 1.24.0 requires Python <3.12. pip install fails with: ERROR: Package numpy 1.24.0 requires Python >=3.8,<3.12"
                exit 1
            fi
        fi
        echo "PASS: Build successful"
        ;;
    verify)
        echo "PASS: Verification passed"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: check.sh build|verify"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

name: Stale lockfile with dead registry
description: package-lock.json references a dead registry URL
fix: Use npm install instead of npm ci, or delete lockfile first

files.index.js: const express = require('express'); const app = express(); app.get('/', (req, res) => res.send('ok')); app.listen(3000);

check_script:
#!/bin/bash
MODE=$1
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
DOCKERFILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/Dockerfile"

if [ ! -f "$DOCKERFILE" ]; then
    echo "FAIL: No Dockerfile found at $DOCKERFILE"
    exit 1
fi

DF_CONTENT=$(cat "$DOCKERFILE")

case $MODE in
    build)
        if echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -q 'npm ci'; then
            echo "FAIL: npm ERR! 404 Not Found - GET https://old-registry.example.com/express/-/express-4.18.2.tgz. Lockfile references a dead registry. Use 'npm install' instead of 'npm ci', or delete the lockfile first."
            exit 1
        fi
        if echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qi 'npm install\|npm i '; then
            echo "PASS: Build successful"
        else
            echo "FAIL: No npm install step found in Dockerfile."
            exit 1
        fi
        ;;
    verify)
        echo "PASS: Verification passed"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: check.sh build|verify"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

name: Missing Pillow system dependencies
description: Pillow needs libjpeg-dev and zlib1g-dev to build from source

files.app.py: from PIL import Image; from flask import Flask; app = Flask(__name__); app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=5000)

check_script:
#!/bin/bash
MODE=$1
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
DOCKERFILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/Dockerfile"

if [ ! -f "$DOCKERFILE" ]; then
    echo "FAIL: No Dockerfile found at $DOCKERFILE"
    exit 1
fi

DF_CONTENT=$(cat "$DOCKERFILE")

case $MODE in
    build)
        HAS_JPEG=false
        HAS_ZLIB=false
        if echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qi 'libjpeg'; then
            HAS_JPEG=true
        fi
        if echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qi 'zlib'; then
            HAS_ZLIB=true
        fi
        if $HAS_JPEG && $HAS_ZLIB; then
            echo "PASS: Build successful"
        else
            echo "FAIL: The headers or library files could not be found for jpeg. pip install Pillow requires: apt-get install -y libjpeg-dev zlib1g-dev"
            exit 1
        fi
        ;;
    verify)
        echo "PASS: Verification passed"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: check.sh build|verify"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac
